heading_fil: Sinabi, nakita, at hindi pa tiyak
display_fil: Ayon kay Liza / ayon sa kapitbahay / direktang nakita / hindi pa natiyak. Walang card na naipakita: hindi patunay ng hindi pagpunta.
display_en: Liza reports / neighbor reports / directly observed / unconfirmed. No card shown does not prove nonattendance.
narration_fil: Si Gibs, isang lalaking BHW, ay bumisita kay Liza, 29, para sa awtorisadong household profile. Nagpaalam siya at nakinig muna. Sinabi ni Liza: “Mahirap pumunta kapag walang magbabantay sa dalawang anak ko.” Sabi ng kapitbahay: “Hindi siya interesado.” Sa pagsasanay na ito, hindi ito aktuwal na rekord. Ihiwalay ang apat na hanay: sinabi ni Liza, iniulat ng kapitbahay, direktang nakita, at hindi pa natiyak. Nang hilingin ang appointment card, nakita ni Gibs na walang card na naipakita sa pag-uusap. Hindi nito pinatutunayang walang appointment o hindi pumunta si Liza. Hindi pa nakita ni Gibs ang awtorisadong attendance record. Ang petsa at status ng pagbisita ay hindi pa nakumpirma. Ang pagtango, pananahimik o pagtingin sa pinto ay obserbasyon lamang, hindi patunay ng pagsang-ayon, pagtanggi, damdamin o diagnosis.
narration_en: Gibs, a male BHW, visits Liza, 29, for an authorized household profile. He asks permission and listens first. Liza says: “Getting there is difficult when nobody can look after my two children.” The neighbor says: “She is not interested.” This rehearsal is not an actual record. Separate four columns: Liza’s report, the neighbor’s report, direct observations, and unconfirmed details. When the appointment card is requested, Gibs observes that no card is shown during the conversation. This does not prove that Liza had no appointment or did not attend. Gibs has not seen the authorized attendance record. The visit date and status remain unconfirmed. A nod, silence or glance toward the door is only an observation, not proof of agreement, refusal, feelings or a diagnosis.

display_fil: Layunin → kaugnay na detalye → awtorisadong gamit. Walang tsismis, hula sa patlang o pangako ng ganap na lihim.
display_en: Purpose → relevant detail → authorized use. No gossip, guessed entries or absolute secrecy promise.
narration_fil: “Para po ito sa awtorisadong household profile at pagpaplano ng serbisyong pangkalusugan,” paliwanag ni Gibs. “Kaugnay na impormasyon lamang ang gagamitin ng awtorisadong health team ayon sa lokal na patakaran. Maaari po ba nating linawin ang hadlang sa pagpunta?” Pinili ni Liza ang Filipino at isang mas tahimik na lugar. Ang hadlang sa pagpunta ay kaugnay ng gawaing ito; ang tsismis tungkol sa utang ng kapitbahay ay hindi. Hindi kailangan ang tunay na pangalan o address sa papel ng pagsasanay. Huwag hulaan ang patlang sa opisyal na form. Hindi pangako ng ganap na lihim ang paliwanag sa paggamit. Kung may tanong tungkol sa pagwawasto, access o pag-iingat ng rekord, itanong ang aktuwal na lokal na proseso sa awtorisadong tagapangasiwa; huwag mag-imbento ng iisang form o petsa ng pagbura. Kung kailangan ng agarang tulong, sundin ang lokal na proseso at huwag itong ipagpaliban para matapos ang interview.
narration_en: “This is for an authorized household profile and health-service planning,” Gibs explains. “Only relevant information will be used by the authorized health team under local policy. May we clarify the barrier to getting there?” Liza chooses Filipino and a quieter place. The access barrier is relevant to this task; gossip about the neighbor’s debt is not. Real names or addresses are unnecessary on the rehearsal sheet. Do not guess missing entries on an official form. Explaining information use is not a promise of absolute secrecy. For questions about correction, access or keeping records, ask the authorized custodian about the actual local process; do not invent a universal form or deletion date. If immediate help is needed, follow the local process and do not delay it to finish the interview.

display_fil: Liza: hindi nakapunta; hindi tiyak ang pagkansela. Kapitbahay: opinyon tungkol sa interes. Panatilihin ang pinagmulan at paglilinaw.
display_en: Liza: unable to attend; cancellation uncertain. Neighbor: opinion about interest. Keep attribution and clarification.
narration_fil: Sabi ni Liza: “Kinansela ang schedule.” Sabi ng kapitbahay: “Ayaw niyang pumunta.” Hindi pipili si Gibs dahil mas malakas ang boses ng isa. “Ano po ang ibig ninyong sabihin sa kinansela?” tanong niya kay Liza. “Hindi ako nakapunta noong wala ang kapatid ko. Hindi ko tiyak kung kinansela ng center,” paglilinaw niya. Ibinuod ni Gibs: “Hindi kayo nakapunta nang wala ang kapatid ninyo; hindi pa tiyak ang status ng schedule. Tama po ba?” “Opo,” sagot ni Liza. Itala ang paglilinaw bilang sinabi ni Liza at panatilihing malinaw ang pinagmulan ng unang pahayag at pagwawasto. Kung mahalaga sa gawain ang ulat ng kapitbahay, iugnay ito sa kanya; hindi ito katunayan ng motibo ni Liza. Ang pagtitiwala at maingat na pagberipika ay magkasabay. Huwag tawaging sinungaling o hindi sumusunod ang residente dahil lamang magkaiba ang kuwento.
narration_en: Liza says: “The schedule was canceled.” The neighbor says: “She did not want to go.” Gibs does not choose a story because one voice is louder. “What do you mean by canceled?” he asks Liza. “I could not go when my sister was away. I am not sure whether the center canceled it,” she clarifies. Gibs summarizes: “You could not go when your sister was away; the schedule status is still uncertain. Is that right?” “Yes,” Liza replies. Record this as Liza’s clarification, keeping the source of the first statement and its correction clear. If the neighbor’s report is relevant to the task, attribute it to the neighbor; it is not proof of Liza’s motive. Trust and careful verification work together. Do not label a resident dishonest or noncompliant merely because accounts differ.

heading_fil: Beripikahin ang kulang, itama nang tapat
heading_en: Verify the gap and correct honestly
display_fil: Bago: tiyak na pagkansela. Pagkatapos: sinabi ni Liza + paglilinaw + nakita + hindi pa nakumpirma. Beripikahin ang petsa/status sa awtorisadong rekord.
display_en: Before: cancellation stated as fact. After: Liza’s report + clarification + observation + unconfirmed gap. Verify date/status in the authorized record.
narration_fil: Maling paunang tala: “Kinansela ng center ang appointment.” Ginawa nitong tiyak ang hindi pa natiyak. Iwinasto ni Gibs sa kathang-isip na practice sheet: “Unang sinabi ni Liza: kinansela ang schedule. Paglilinaw ni Liza sa pag-uusap: hindi siya nakapunta nang wala ang kapatid; hindi niya tiyak kung kinansela ng center. Walang card na naipakita. Petsa at status: hindi pa nakumpirma.” Hindi niya pinalitan ang hula ng panibagong hula. Isang angkop na hakbang: hilingin sa awtorisadong midwife na tingnan kasama niya ang kaugnay na attendance record, ayon sa lokal na access procedure. Tanungin lamang ang kailangan; hindi kailangang siyasatin ang buong buhay ni Liza. Kinumpirma ni Liza ang buod ng sarili niyang sinabi at handa siyang linawin ang petsang naaalala niya. Ito ang totoong pagtatapos ng pag-uusap, hindi kumpirmasyon ng attendance o bagong appointment. Hangga’t wala ang angkop na beripikasyon, manatiling “hindi pa nakumpirma” ang puwang. Sa totoong rekord, sundin ang lokal na proseso sa pagwawasto at panatilihin ang pinagmulan ng pagbabago.
narration_en: Incorrect initial note: “The center canceled the appointment.” It treats unconfirmed information as established. Gibs corrects the fictional practice sheet: “Liza first reported a canceled schedule. Liza clarified during the conversation that she could not attend when her sister was away and was unsure whether the center canceled it. No card was shown. Date and status: not yet confirmed.” He does not replace one guess with another. One suitable step is to ask the authorized midwife to check the relevant attendance record with him under the local access procedure. Ask only what is needed; do not investigate Liza’s entire life. Liza confirms the summary of her own report and is willing to clarify the date she remembers. That is the confirmed ending of the conversation, not confirmation of attendance or a new appointment. Until suitable verification is available, keep the gap marked “not yet confirmed.” In a real record, follow the local correction process and preserve the source of the change.

display_fil: Iayos → iugnay sa pinagmulan → isulat → beripikasyon → iwasto → ulitin. Lahat ay susubok bilang BHW; peer feedback ay hindi grado.
display_en: Sort → attribute → record → verification → correct → repeat. Everyone attempts the BHW role; peer feedback is not a grade.
narration_fil: Gumawa muna ng tatlong kahon: “Sinabi,” “Nakita,” at “Hindi pa tiyak.” Sa unang kahon, paghiwalayin ang “ayon kay Liza” at “ayon sa kapitbahay” upang magkaroon ng apat na hanay sa recording aid. Ilagay ang kathang-isip na source cards sa tamang hanay. Gumawa ng maikling tala na may paglilinaw ni Liza at isang hakbang sa pagberipika ng petsa. Ipasuri kung may hula, diagnosis, husga o hindi kaugnay na detalye. Sa triad, magpalit bilang BHW, residente at tagamasid sa tatlong round upang lahat ay sumubok bilang BHW. Itala ng tagamasid ang eksaktong ebidensya at isang kailangang ulitin; feedback ito, hindi grado ng facilitator. Kung mag-isa, iayos ang papel na cards, salungguhitan ang pinagmulan at iwasto ang tala. Maaaring basahin nang malakas ang cards o gumamit ng gustong wika. Walang internet, projector, totoong resident record o upload na kailangan. Ulitin ang mahirap na bahagi bago magpatuloy.
narration_en: First draw three boxes: “Reported,” “Observed,” and “Unconfirmed.” Split the first box into “Liza reports” and “neighbor reports” to make the recording aid’s four columns. Sort the fictional source cards into the correct column. Write a short note containing Liza’s clarification and one step to verify the date. Check it for guesses, diagnoses, judgments or irrelevant details. In a triad, rotate as BHW, resident and observer through three rounds so everyone attempts the BHW role. The observer records exact evidence and one step to repeat; this is feedback, not a facilitator grade. Alone, sort paper cards, underline sources and correct the note. Cards may be read aloud or used in the preferred language. No internet, projector, real resident record or upload is needed. Repeat the difficult part before continuing.

display_fil: Bago ang paglilinaw: magkaiba ang kuwento, walang card na naipakita, hindi pa nakita ang rekord. Piliin ang angkop na paunang tala.
display_en: Before clarification: accounts differ, no card shown, record not checked. Choose an appropriate initial note.
narration_fil: Bumalik sa unang tagpo, bago ang paglilinaw: sinabi ni Liza na kinansela ang schedule; sabi ng kapitbahay, hindi siya interesado. Walang card na naipakita at hindi pa nakita ni Gibs ang awtorisadong attendance record. Aling paunang tala ang angkop? Piliin at ipaliwanag ang dahilan bago tingnan ang feedback at ang iwinastong tala. Pagkatapos, ihambing sa sarili mong pagsasanay. Ang pagpili sa screen, pagkumpleto ng aralin o panonood ng opsyonal na kuwento ay hindi patunay na kaya mo nang gawin ang gawain.
narration_en: Return to the initial scene, before clarification: Liza reports a canceled schedule; the neighbor says she is not interested. No card has been shown and Gibs has not seen the authorized attendance record. Which initial note is appropriate? Choose and explain your reason before viewing feedback and the corrected note. Then compare it with your practice attempt. A screen choice, lesson completion or watching the optional story does not prove that you can perform the task.

check.prompt_fil: Wala ang card, at hindi magkatugma ang kuwento ni Liza at ng kapitbahay. Aling tala ang angkop?
check.prompt_en: The card is missing and Liza’s account differs from her neighbor’s. Which record fits?

options.fil: “Hindi interesado si Liza; ayon sa kapitbahay.”
options.en: “Liza is not interested, according to the neighbor.”

options.fil: “Ayon kay Liza, kinansela ang schedule; petsa ay ibeberipika sa rekord.”
options.en: “Liza reports a canceled schedule; date to be verified in the record.”

options.fil: “Kinansela ng health center ang lahat ng appointment.”

check.feedback_fil: Una: kahit may “ayon sa kapitbahay,” ang “hindi interesado” ay husga sa motibo, hindi natiyak na katotohanan. Ikalawa: ang ulat ay malinaw na kay Liza at may puwang na ibeberipika; ito ang angkop na paunang tala. Ikatlo: hindi pinatutunayan ng isang ulat na kinansela ang lahat ng appointment. Sa wakas, nilinaw ni Liza na hindi siya nakapunta nang wala ang kapatid at hindi niya tiyak kung kinansela ng center. Iwinastong tala: unang sinabi ni Liza ang pagkansela; nilinaw niya ang hadlang at kawalan ng katiyakan. Walang card na naipakita. Hindi pa nakumpirma ang petsa/status; hilingin sa awtorisadong midwife na tingnan ang kaugnay na rekord ayon sa lokal na access procedure. Kinumpirma ni Liza ang buod ng sarili niyang sinabi, hindi ang attendance o bagong appointment.
check.feedback_en: First: even with “according to the neighbor,” “not interested” is a judgment about motive, not an established fact. Second: the report is clearly attributed to Liza and identifies a gap for verification; this is the appropriate initial note. Third: one report does not establish that every appointment was canceled. In the ending, Liza clarifies that she could not attend when her sister was away and is unsure whether the center canceled it. Corrected note: Liza first reported cancellation; she clarified the barrier and uncertainty. No card was shown. Date/status remain unconfirmed; ask the authorized midwife to check the relevant record under the local access procedure. Liza confirms the summary of her own report, not attendance or a new appointment.
